rationale.A: ~5.6 km in traffic: Malminkaari at 50 km/h, Oulunkyläntie, Pohjolankatu tram rails; unsignalled arterial crossings
rationale.B: Malminkaari side path, then Vantaa/Viikki paths, Kumpulantaival and Vallila valley; no traffic, 3 lights, +3 min
rationale.C: Same as B via the Viikinmäki bridge; slightly shorter
rationale.D: Same family via Arabia/Kumpula with Hämeentie and Kustaa Vaasan tie crossings; 5 lights
rationale.E: No traffic but many side paths (Oulunkyläntie, Käpyläntie, Mäkelänkatu) and 290 m walking
rationale.F: Malmi park paths, Viikki and Vanhankaupunginlahti, Vallila valley; side paths beside Viikintie/Pihlajamäentie
rationale.G: Quiet Malmi streets and park paths, then the B/C corridor; least side path, 2 lights, +6 min
rationale.H: Northern loop with Karhusuontie in traffic and long side paths; +7 min

notes: C (or B) removes all of A's arterial traffic for +3 min, a clear calm win. Fewest lights: C saves 2 lights for 3 min and G saves 3 for 6 min, neither worth a card. G is marginally calmer than C but not worth 3 more minutes.
